official.status: Docs read end to end on 2026-11-02: 23 endpoints including /token, all under /api/Lead and /api/Note. The API covers the online-booking funnel (leads, quotes, pricing, availability, booking) plus notes and a few lookups. It has no endpoints for existing clients, jobs, the schedule, employees, payroll or invoices. Not probed yet (no API user in the session).
official.auth: POST /token (form-encoded) with username and password (grant_type=password), or refresh_token (grant_type=refresh_token); then Authorization: Bearer <token>. Credentials come from an API User (Company > Settings > General > Integrations > API Users).
